chars: the friend in the red beanie
moments.action: At an open wash bay the two stand watching the green Hulk-painted van run through the brushes, talking in reverse angles against the neon street. By the last shot the friend in the beanie is laughing.
A car rolls through a wet underpass at night, then a hooded attendant waiting arms-crossed by a white wall pushes off and works the yellow barrier arm as the pale car noses up to the gate.

chars: the friend in the red beanie
moments.action: Inside the van the newcomer stares out as they roll into a parking garage crowded with girls and parked cars. The wide gives way to a close-up of him, mouth open, taking it in.
The Hulk-painted van creeps down the garage lane past girls crossing in front of it, a tiger-striped car, a red race car with its hood up, ending on a close insert of an exposed engine bay.

chars: the friend in the red beanie
moments.action: A long held two-shot in the van, both of them turning their heads to follow something off-screen, then a cut to dancers' hips moving right past the parked cars.
Fast cuts across the garage party: crowds threading between parked tuners, a yellow coupe filling the foreground, arms thrown up dancing, finishing on a DJ's turntables.

chars: the friend in the red beanie
moments.action: The friend points something out: a blonde woman and a bleach-haired man wrapped around each other, then kissing, then a tattooed girl and a man in a horned red beanie passing. The newcomer's face hardens from curious to flat.

Out of the van now, the newcomer walks the garage floor past cars with hoods up and a man in white leaning into an engine. He drops his eyes, then passes a girl texting on an open trunk full of nitrous bottles.
